title: screen_v1_codebook
description: Output schema for the screen_v1_codebook prompt. One object per abstract. Field order mirrors the six codebook questions. Pair with prompts/screen_v1_codebook.txt.

analyzing_data.description: Q1. Is this manuscript actively analyzing empirical data?

patient_level_health_outcomes.description: Q2. Does the analysis involve individual patient-level data evaluating health or clinical outcomes? Not Applicable when Q1 is No.

evidence_of_randomization.description: Q3. Copied or paraphrased allocation language from the abstract, or 'No allocation language found'.

intervention_randomized.description: Q4. Was the intervention individually randomised, based on Q3 evidence?

reasoning.description: Q5. One short paragraph synthesizing Q1-4 into a final CONSORT-eligibility judgment.
